title: Objects with transparency in shadermaterial always render in front of collisionshape debug render
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4, 4.3 as far I can tell seems to be present everywhere I tested it. 

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.13031.3015) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Actual visual: 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f693d02-4dd3-40a8-bf43-d35efa625e67)

expected output (with colour of course): 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f8e534c-0d2b-4a9d-b1b5-bbb6588ad825)

I looked through the render_mode options and tested all of them, asked around, looked for similar issues but came up empty.
I figured I would rather report it as a bug and be proven wrong instead of not reporting it, this seems a rather annoying issue.
It can however be worked around by removing the alpha value from the shader while debugging the collision shape, but that seems suboptimal.

### Steps to reproduce

 Self-evident when you open the project really. 
1) Create a shadermaterial and apply it to a mesh
2) in the shader, define the ALPHA property
3) observe object in 3D space render in front of everything

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[issue_shader.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20144029/issue_shader.zip)
I've set the ALPHA = min(tex_color.a, tint_color.a) if I am seeing this correctly that would be min(0, 1)
